parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue of posify removing the finite assumption, but it may not handle all edge cases or assumptions correctly.

issues.description: The patch only addresses the finite assumption and does not handle other assumptions like integer, rational, prime, even, odd, etc. This may lead to incomplete resolution of the issue.
The code could be more readable by using a dictionary comprehension instead of a for loop for creating the `reps` dictionary.
